# T-3: Unify plugin help rendering

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Normalize plugin command metadata into the shared help renderer while keeping plugin command discovery and execution registration unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Plugin top-level help entries are rendered through the same renderer as core command entries.
- Plugin command and subcommand help use normalized metadata and preserve semantic descriptions and usage.
- No convention-based plugin command discovery is added.

## Implementation Notes
Use existing `PluginManifest.commandEntries()` / `loadPluginRegistry(root).commands` as input. Do not change plugin command execution dispatch.

## Test Strategy
Use fixture plugin metadata to verify top-level, command, and subcommand help rendering through the shared renderer.
